# @three-ws/skill-license

> On-chain skill licenses for agents — each purchased skill is a 1/1 SPL NFT plus a deterministic SkillLicense PDA. Mint, verify, and read trustless skill access in one import, no database required.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-skill-license
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-skill-license/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/skill-license
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws
